title: The mind-brain problem reduces to the interaction of each dendron with its psychon

statements.text: With every psychon linked to one dendron, the mind-brain problem reduces to the interaction between a dendron and its psychon, for all 40 million linked units. The interaction gives a basis for effective selection by a process analogous to a quantal probability field, developing Eccles's 1986 proposal that synaptic microsites involve particles small enough to fall within the range of the uncertainty principle.

sources.quote: So the mind-brain problem reduces to the interaction between a dendron and its psychon for all the 40 million linked units.
The psychon-dendron interaction provides a much improved basis for effective selection by a process analogous to a quantal probability field.
